WEAKNESS_HEXAGRAM_INTERPRETATIONS.perfectionism: The Qian hexagram's 'flying dragon in the heavens' reminds us that even the 'hidden dragon' must wait. Perfectionism seeks to leap to the summit, ignoring the virtue of gradual progress.
WEAKNESS_HEXAGRAM_INTERPRETATIONS.socialAvoidance: The Sun hexagram subtracts from below to benefit above. Social avoidance stems from self-enclosure. Let down your guard to receive nourishment from relationships.
WEAKNESS_HEXAGRAM_INTERPRETATIONS.moodSwings: The Yi hexagram joins wind and thunder. When emotions storm, channel their momentum upward rather than being consumed by them.
WEAKNESS_HEXAGRAM_INTERPRETATIONS.indecision: The Zhun hexagram marks birth's difficulty. New beginnings demand decisive action — hesitation only deepens the struggle.
